family.description: This family includes Endonuclease dU from Archaeoglobus fulgidus (Endo_dU, AF_1433) and similar proteins mainly found in archaea. Sequence and structure analysis to identify RNase H-like superfamily members, has clustered this family in endonuclease Clade V, thus suggesting endonuclease activity of these proteins [[cite:PUB00098031]]. Endo_dU, which cleave the 3'-side of deoxyuridine (dU) on DNA substrates, shows a typical RNase H-like fold, with a core structure of five beta-strands and three alpha-helices. It may participate in DNA repair [[cite:PUB00160071]]. This family was formerly known as DUF99.
family.name: Endonuclease dU

record.description: This family includes Endonuclease dU from Archaeoglobus fulgidus (Endo_dU, AF_1433) and similar proteins mainly found in archaea. Sequence and structure analysis to identify RNase H-like superfamily members, has clustered this family in endonuclease Clade V, thus suggesting endonuclease activity of these proteins [[cite:PUB00098031]]. Endo_dU, which cleave the 3'-side of deoxyuridine (dU) on DNA substrates, shows a typical RNase H-like fold, with a core structure of five beta-strands and three alpha-helices. It may participate in DNA repair [[cite:PUB00160071]]. This family was formerly known as DUF99.

evidence.explanation: Main Figures4/5/7 and supplementS5/S11 were inspected. Zinc precipitation, pH4 versus tested5-10, first salt lane5 versus50mM and S5 timing remain explicit.

discussions.notes: Obtain actual construct sequences and independently measured product termini, active protein concentration and bound-metal information. EDTA resistance alone is not proof of an apoenzyme. See evidence/PF01949/li-2024-perturbations.txt.

discussions.rationale: D10A retains cleavage; Figure7E says D10A+H166R while Results and S11 say D10A-H166A. No H166 single-mutant effect or native folding control is established.

DS2 reference D4GRY4 maps PF01949 26-197; this is not an independently sequenced H26 clone.

discussions.notes: Resolve current Pfam boundaries for WP_009487363.1 and TLY50285.1; retain their primary DUF99 assignment and do not substitute COG1628 coordinates. RNA-seq deposit PRJNA1072706 remains unanalyzed.
discussions.prompt: Verify historical constructs and the H26 deletion allele without conflating HaloDL1 biochemistry with H. volcanii physiology.
discussions.rationale: Whole-protein activity is not isolated-domain catalysis; partial deletion, neighboring UDG and relative TPM do not demonstrate a complete repair pathway.

evidence.explanation: Example1 is an earlier Afu/Halo ssDNA experiment; OLS17807.1 and PWI48783.1 are additional leads, not the Loki/Thor clones in Li2024.

discussions.notes: Review patent figures and sequence listings, imported PMID24464998 and later renamed-member literature. Conservation, fold similarity, gene proximity and EX_DUF naming are not direct catalytic evidence. All records and prior follow-ups remain in scope.
